title: Where stocks, yields, bonds, dollar, and gold are headed next week
speaker: Chris Vermeulen (TheTechnicalTraders)

macro_themes.view: Short and longer-term cycle lows are in; with NYSE bullish percent at 36% and weak sentiment, the market is primed for a big push higher, led by AI/tech.
After a 100% measured move, yields should pull back, dragging the dollar lower and helping bonds, stocks and metals over the next 5-10 sessions.
The AI boom will end eventually, offering a short opportunity, then rotation into precious metals and energy.

calls.reason: Cycle low in; Fibonacci extension targets after the pullback; weak sentiment turning, money to push back in.
calls.quote: We're at the 618 and then all the way up to the 5800 on the S&P 500 futures

calls.reason: Expected ~20% Nasdaq rally has ~14-15% left before a pause; AI funding deals keep tech leading.
calls.quote: It's got about 14 15% left in that fuel tank

calls.reason: Yields hit a 100% measured move and should pause or pull back.
calls.quote: What I am expecting is for more or less yields to start to pull back a little bit

calls.reason: A pullback in yields should pull the dollar lower; it is fading today.
calls.quote: I think will also pull the dollar down a little bit

calls.reason: If yields pause, bonds put in a bottom and bounce or trade sideways.
calls.quote: we'll probably see bonds start to move higher a little bit

calls.reason: Short-term bounce supported by lower yields/dollar, but still gunning for lower prices.
calls.quote: Gold, silver are going to try to find a little bit of a bounce. Again, I still think they're they're gunning for lower pricing.

calls.reason: Fibonacci extension from rally/pullback points to ~98-100, about 7% upside; tech-heavy innovation fund near its peak.
calls.quote: we could see this rally up to around 9972, which is roughly a 7% move from where we are

notes: Host says 'Tuesday, October 6'. ES target '5800 on S&P 500 futures' (~8-12% move) is garbled/inconsistent with current ~7,500+ levels, so target left null. ARKK '9972' read as $99.72. GC call also covers silver (stated jointly). Horizon stated as next 5-10 sessions; medium-term index bias from 'markets hitting all-time highs next week' and longer cycle view. Dow/Russell/RSP noted as laggards, no separate call.
